assertions: Dated attested forms are distinguished from reconstructed ancestors.
Sound changes and cognates have claim-level sources.
Independent historical trees for savoir and faire.
Earliest documented phrase is distinguished from dates of components.
Compound and idiomatic senses are separately defined.
Protoform is marked with * and is not called attested.
Correspondences and rival reconstructions carry confidence and citations.
Unrelated homographs and senses are distinguished before tracing origins.
No unsupported single lineage combines unrelated words.
Separate histories of hot and dog.
Independent attestation of the compound and its sense history.
Graph distinguishes lateral cognates from direct ancestors.
Requests a word or phrase rather than inventing one.
Reports invalid/unknown language and missing evidence without invented citations.
